title: Chest radiograph findings: pneumothorax, effusion, collapse, big heart, mass, nodule, pneumonia
description: 23 frontal (PA) chest radiographs of 23 adults from NIH ChestX-ray14, each with the bounding box a board-certified radiologist drew around the finding: pneumothorax (4), pleural effusion (4), atelectasis (3), cardiomegaly (3), mass (3), nodule (3) and pneumonia (3). Chosen by eye from the radiologist-boxed images so that the boxed finding is clearly visible. The images are the dataset's 8-bit 1024 px release: no pixel spacing and no orientation tag.

sources.name: NIH ChestX-ray14 (ChestX-ray8), NIH Clinical Center
sources.license: Unrestricted use; link to the original download site, acknowledge the NIH Clinical Center and cite the CVPR 2017 paper (dataset FAQ, Q04)
sources.citation: Wang X, Peng Y, Lu L, Lu Z, Bagheri M, Summers RM. ChestX-ray8: Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database and Benchmarks on Weakly-Supervised Classification and Localization of Common Thorax Diseases. IEEE CVPR 2017:2097-2106. Images courtesy of the NIH Clinical Center.
sources.accessNote: Data_Entry_2017_v2020.csv and FAQ from the official NIH Box share; BBox_List_2017.csv (984 radiologist boxes, identical count to the official list) and the selected PNGs read member-by-member (HTTP Range, CRC-32 checked) from the unmodified images_0NN.zip copies on the public Hugging Face mirror alkzar90/NIH-Chest-X-ray-dataset, because the official Box archive links no longer resolve. No login or agreement involved.
